# Curated buffer of Phosphor icons that CMS free-text icon fields (industry
# sectors, proof cards) may reference beyond what's currently used on the site.
# Included in the subset (tools/subset-phosphor.mjs) so an admin picking a
# sensible icon doesn't render blank. One base icon name per line (no "ph-").
# Names without a codepoint in vendor/phosphor/style.css are silently skipped.
# Keep this broad but reasonable — every entry adds a glyph to the shipped font.
